entities.name: MONDO:0008666
observations: Midgut volvulus is a congenital rotational abnormality that can cause intestinal obstruction; the vignette's acute-on-progressive pain, vomiting, obstipation, and upper abdominal distention are compatible but not diagnostic.
Intussusception commonly presents in children with episodic pain and vomiting; bloody stool or a palpable mass may occur but are not universal.

observations: Best-fit clinical interpretation of progressive abdominal pain, vomiting, obstipation, and upper abdominal tympany in this child; the presentation is insufficient to confirm the diagnosis.
